# Template for deploying apps in the monorepo
# Copy this file and customize the environment variables below

name: Deploy [APP_NAME]

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        required: true
        type: choice
        description: Choose environment
        options:
          - dev
          - prd
  push:
    branches:
      - dev
    paths:
      - '[APP_PATH]/**'

permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

env:
  # App Configuration - CUSTOMIZE THESE VALUES
  SERVICE_NAME: '[SERVICE_NAME]'            # e.g., 'user-api', 'admin-dashboard'
  APP_PATH: '[APP_PATH]'                    # e.g., 'apps/user-api'
  DOCKERFILE_PATH: 'dockerfile'             # Path to Dockerfile (usulifeline 'dockerfile')
  BUILD_COMMAND: '[BUILD_COMMAND]'          # e.g., 'npm run build', 'npm run build:prod'
  NODE_VERSION: '[NODE_VERSION]'            # e.g., '18', '20'
  PORT: '[PORT]'                           # e.g., '3000', '8080'

jobs:
  # Check if there are changes in the app directory
  changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      app: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.app }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check for changes
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: changes
        with:
          filters: |
            app:
              - '${{ env.APP_PATH }}/**'
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  # Determine target environment
  determine-environment:
    needs: changes
    if: |
      needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      target_env: ${{ steps.env.outputs.target_env }}
      should_deploy: ${{ steps.env.outputs.should_deploy }}
    steps:
      - name: Determine Environment
        id: env
        run: |
          BRANCH="${GITHUB_REF#refs/heads/}"
          MANUAL_ENV="${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}"
          
          # Determine target environment
          if [ -n "$MANUAL_ENV" ]; then
            TARGET_ENV="$MANUAL_ENV"
          else
            case $BRANCH in
              "dev")
                TARGET_ENV="dev"
                ;;
              "prd")
                TARGET_ENV="prd"
                ;;
              *)
                echo "No deployment configured for branch: $BRANCH"
                TARGET_ENV=""
                ;;
            esac
          fi
          
          if [ -n "$TARGET_ENV" ]; then
            echo "target_env=$TARGET_ENV" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "should_deploy=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo ":rocket: Deploying to: $TARGET_ENV" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          else
            echo "should_deploy=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo ":warning: No deployment target determined" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          fi

  # Deploy to determined environment
  deploy:
    needs: 
      - changes
      - determine-environment
    if: needs.determine-environment.outputs.should_deploy == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy-ecs-service.yml
    with:
      service_name: ${{ env.SERVICE_NAME }}
      app_path: ${{ env.APP_PATH }}
      environment: ${{ needs.determine-environment.outputs.target_env }}
      dockerfile_path: ${{ env.DOCKERFILE_PATH }}
      build_command: ${{ env.BUILD_COMMAND }}
      node_version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
      port: ${{ env.PORT }}

  # Build and test on pull requests (no deployment)
  test:
    needs: changes
    if: |
      needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' && 
      github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: '${{ env.APP_PATH }}/package-lock.json'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        working-directory: ${{ env.APP_PATH }}
        run: |
          if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
            npm ci --legacy-peer-deps
          else
            npm install
          fi

      - name: Run Tests
        working-directory: ${{ env.APP_PATH }}
        run: |
          # Run tests if test script exists
          if npm run | grep -q "test"; then
            npm run test
          else
            echo "No test script found, skipping tests"
          fi

      - name: Build Application
        working-directory: ${{ env.APP_PATH }}
        run: ${{ env.BUILD_COMMAND }}

      - name: PR Summary
        run: |
          echo ":white_check_mark: Build and tests completed successfully!" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Service: ${{ env.SERVICE_NAME }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Branch: ${{ github.head_ref }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- No deployment performed (PR only)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
